run_gen_build_yaml: run the gen_build_yaml.py script to generate YAML build configuration for c-ares library
gen_ares_build: run buildconf and configure scripts to generate c-ares build headers via subprocess
config_platform: return the platform-specific ares_config.h header path for darwin, freebsd, linux, or openbsd
ares_build: return the path to ares_build.h or generate it if missing via buildconf
summarize_gen_build_yaml: summarize the gen_build_yaml.py script that outputs c-ares source and header lists as YAML
